tables.name: orders
tables.description: 注文情報。顧客、注文状態、支払方法を管理します。

indexes.name: orders_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON public.orders USING btree (id)

indexes.name: orders_customer_created_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX orders_customer_created_idx ON public.orders USING btree (customer_id, created_at DESC) INCLUDE (total_amount)

indexes.name: orders_pending_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX orders_pending_idx ON public.orders USING btree (created_at) WHERE status_code = 'pending'

tables.name: customers
tables.description: 顧客情報。注文の購入者を識別するためのテーブルです。

indexes.name: customers_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON public.customers USING btree (id)

tables.name: active_orders
tables.description: 処理中の注文を顧客名付きで参照するビュー（デモ）。
tables.definition: SELECT o.id, c.display_name AS customer_name, o.total_amount FROM public.orders o JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status_code = 'processing';

tables.description: 注文の状態を定義するマスター。orders.status_code から参照されます。
